title: Flavor Framework
description: A lightweight mod that adds various foods to the game.
body:
![Flavor Framework Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1efc3fa05f6e7a1fa073abe108b91a4d0208ca78.png)
# Minecraft's food variety can get kind of boring...
# So I fixed it.

### _Overview_

Flavor Framework is a lightweight Minecraft mod that plans to extend Minecraft food in a way that feels natural to the classic game.

## _Features_

The mod currently adds **8 new kinds of fruit** with **2 fruits having a variant.** Along with some **juices** that enhance a fruits saturation while decreasing the amount of hunger it fills.

**Items Added:**
- Orange (Found in Acacia leaves)
- Golden Orange
- Orange Juice
- Apple Juice
- Lemon (Found in Birch leaves)
- Lemonade
- Banana (Found in Jungle leaves)
- Pear (Found in Azalea leaves)
- Bloomed Pear (Found in Flowering Azalea leaves)
- Cherries (Found in Cherry Blossom leaves)
- Blueberries (Found in Spruce leaves)
- Mango (Found in Mangrove leaves)
- Pale Pepper (Found in Pale Oak leaves)

**Juices** are crafted simply by adding the desired fruit, sugar and a glass bottle.![Orange Juice Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b6f8b0e40c38b70e44bc7794b721fa04148de0f.png)

Some **fruits** are rarer and give you special effects. An example is the **Bloomed Pear** This gives you 4 hearts instantly but gives you nausea for 15 seconds.
